Description: Enable the administrator to create and manage monthly reading challenges with books, deadlines and achievement criteria.
Enable members to find challenges, join them and record their reading progress and history.
Enable members to review books and discuss them with other members.
Motivate members by ranking them on completed books and challenge achievements.
Enable the administrator to keep discussions respectful and restrict admin tools to admins.

As a club administrator,
I want to create a reading challenge by selecting books,
So that members have a monthly challenge to take part in.

As a club administrator,
I want to set reading deadlines and define achievement criteria for a challenge,
So that members know what to finish and by when.

Summary: Story 1.3: Edit or Close a Challenge
Description:
As a club administrator,
I want to edit or close a challenge,
So that I can correct mistakes or end a challenge early.

As a member,
I want to browse the available reading challenges,
So that I can choose one that interests me.

As a member,
I want to join a reading challenge,
So that my reading counts towards that challenge.

As a member,
I want to mark my progress and mark a book as completed,
So that my achievements are tracked.

As a member,
I want to view my reading history,
So that I can see all the books I have finished.

As a member who has completed a book,
I want to submit a review and a 1 to 5 rating,
So that I can share my opinion with other readers.

Summary: Story 3.2: Post Comment on a Book
Description:
As a member,
I want to post a comment in a book's discussion,
So that I can talk about the book with others.

As a member,
I want to reply to another member's comment,
So that conversations stay organised in threads.

As a member,
I want to view a leaderboard ranked by completed books and challenge achievements,
So that I feel motivated to read more.

As a member,
I want to be awarded an achievement when I meet a challenge's criteria,
So that my effort is recognised.

As a club administrator,
I want to remove inappropriate posts from discussions,
So that the community stays respectful.

As a club administrator,
I want to suspend members who repeatedly violate community rules,
So that they cannot keep harming the discussions.
